header.about: Cross-checks for exp/hr Model D under Quicksilver (R10: rest and meditate restore mana, so hit points and mana recover in one phase). The engine has no exp/hr figure, so the cases are built from its own regeneration ticks played second by second. kind cycle: hit points and mana gained over one 210-second cycle (the least common multiple of the 30, 21 and 15 second ticks), resting or meditating, with the engine's rest-tick and slow-tick hit points in inputs. kind recovery: seconds until the missing hit points and the missing mana are both restored, from a standing rate, resting or meditating; inputs.rest_hp is the rest-tick hit point gain. v120 is the 1.20.0 balance; neutral has both mana multiples at 1.
